{{Quote|There's the Corellian agent, sir. He doesn't know who Habuur was after, only that Corellian Intelligence told him to give her a safe house and provide weapons.|Heol Girdun, to Jacen Solo|<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines">''[[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines]]''</ref>}}
'''Buroy''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] who served as an agent of [[Corellian Intelligence]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Second Galactic Civil War|Second Corellian Crisis]]. In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], the Corellian [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Thrackan Sal-Solo]] hired the [[Kiffar/Legends|Kiffar]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Ailyn Vel]]&mdash;who was operating under the alias "Ailyn Harbuur"&mdash;to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] [[Solo family/Legends|the family]] of Sal-Solo's cousin [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], and Buroy was ordered by Corellian Intelligence to provide Vel with weapons and a safe house on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. However, Buroy and Vel were arrested by the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]] and after Vel was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during an interrogation by the GAG's leader [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]], who was attempting to extract intelligence from her regarding Sal-Solo's plot, Jacen ordered the GAG [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Heol Girdun]] to try to obtain the information from Buroy instead.
